claim: A/R Aging Collection and A/P Aging Summary: with the computer offline, changing the as-of date shows no 'Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again.' message (and no standard error message); the old rows stay under the new date

positive_control.evidence: p62/02-C715442-2-server-500.png and 05-C715443-2-server-500.png: same page, same date chip, online, with only the report's own data call answered 500 -> 'Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again.' in place of the rows plus the toast 'Ooooops! An error occurred'. The message exists and the screen read sees it.

tried_through_the_screen.evidence: The as-of date was changed through the As of chip's calendar (filt.mjs asOf) on the real report pages; picture p62/01-C715442-1-offline.png shows the chip reading 'As of: 11/03/2026'.

waited_and_retried.evidence: Two attempts per report: s78b (11 Nov ~13:40 UTC, offline, as-of changed, no message) and p62 (11 Nov 14:05-14:08 UTC, fresh page, polled 30 s after the change for the message and any toast).

checked_for_navigation.evidence: Same report URL and page in the offline picture; single page context, no new tab; the chip shows the new date.

precondition_read_back.evidence: p62/out.json offline.net: the browser was offline (favicon and analytics calls failed with net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED); 3 Nov was never loaded on that fresh page, so no stored answer could stand in; after going back online the date change to today loads 33 rows (after.rows).

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'went wrong loading this report' over build/: only our cases, the PRD extract and these probes; draft 04 covers the Detail BUCKET messages (Story 4, SV-11534), not this report-level message (Story 8, SV-11538). JQL to be re-run before the ask.

asked_what_would_make_this_my_fault.evidence: (1) The date change might not have happened offline - ruled out, the chip reads 11/03/2026. (2) Reading too early - ruled out, 30 s polling. (3) A cached answer - ruled out, 3 Nov never loaded on that page and no report call was even attempted (the request log shows none). (4) The message may need a server answer - that is the finding: the page does not try to load and says nothing, while the rows of the previous date stay under the new date.
